transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad almost every single day. This constant heavy mood has been going on for about a year and ten months now. I just can't seem to shake this feeling.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, overly happy, or hyperactive, perhaps needing much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never had any periods like that. Honestly, I've only felt down, tired, and completely low this entire time. I haven't felt energetic or unusually happy at all.
During this year and ten months, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where your mood returned to normal and you felt like yourself again?

No, I don't think I've had any periods where my mood went back to normal. It feels like this state has been completely continuous throughout the entire year and ten months. I haven't felt like my usual self at all during this time.
Along with feeling down, have you noticed other changes like trouble sleeping, changes in your appetite, low energy, poor concentration, or feelings of hopelessness?

Yes, my sleep is terrible—I struggle to fall asleep and wake up constantly throughout the night, feeling completely exhausted. My appetite has also changed quite a bit, and I find it really hard to concentrate or remember simple things lately.

No, it hasn't really been mild or on-and-off. These heavy depressive feelings have been going on continuously for about a year and ten months now without any relief.
Before this year and ten months began, had you ever experienced any other periods of depression or low mood in your life?
No, I hadn't experienced anything like this before. Prior to this starting, my mood was generally fine and I didn't struggle with depression. This is the first time in my life I've felt this way.
Sometimes when depression is very severe, people might hear or see things that others can't, or have strong beliefs that others find unusual. Have you experienced anything like that?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I have never heard or seen things that others couldn't, nor have I had any unusual beliefs.
Sometimes when people feel this down, they might have thoughts of death or hurting themselves. Have you experienced any thoughts like that?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or death. Even though things have been incredibly hard and heavy, I've never felt like I wanted to end my life.
How have these symptoms affected your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or ability to take care of things at home?

I've completely isolated myself from my friends and family because I just don't have the energy to connect with anyone anymore. At work and home, I can barely get anything done because I have absolutely no motivation to start or finish tasks. It's also become incredibly hard to focus, and even making simple, daily decisions feels completely overwhelming.
